headline: Redistricting update, a beverage cooler contract, an e-bike safety policy revision, and a Grade 12 out-of-state trip.
summary: The meeting covers school redistricting and EXCEL Program enrollment, 2026 MCAS results, and a Constellations memo and report. It also includes a beverage cooler contract, an e-bike safety policy revision, and a Grade 12 out-of-state trip.
items: Redistricting update: RFP timeline and EXCEL Program enrollment statistics
Alternative sales beverage coolers contract: approval
E-bike and micromobility safety policy revised: approval
Negotiation committee nominations and appointments: approval for Unit B Administrators, Unit D Secretaries, Cafeteria Employees, and Nurses
Any other business from the committee
location: Media Center, Methuen High School, 1 Ranger Road, Methuen, MA
